shortDescription: Brookfield Asset Management has agreed to acquire Reliance Worldwide Corp. in an all-cash transaction valuing the Australian plumbing supplies company at about A$4.1 billion ($2.9 billion), according to Bloomberg.

title: Brookfield to Buy Reliance Worldwide in A$4.1 Billion All-Cash Deal
